notes.title: Yume Kakigori is 🎈Now Serving!🎈
notes.content:
[h2]Yume Kakigori officially launches today—on this special Shaved Ice Day![/h2][p][/p][p]After two years of heartfelt development, we’re so happy to finally bring [i]Yume Kakigori[/i] to you.[/p][p]Thank you for being with us during this journey.
We hope you enjoy your time at the little shaved ice shop above the clouds.
[/p][p]If possible, please let us know your comment on Steam Review.
Take your time, and please enjoy [i]Yume Kakigori[/i].

—Emotions unfold in shaved ice, a journey of self-discovery.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45161397/58c1b94c53359e7f47d96f955ce7b7fb27842ac7.png"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2795660/Yume_Kakigori/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Yume Kakigori has reached 🎉1000 wishlists🎉 thank you!!
notes.content:
[h3]Yume Kakigori has reached 1000 wishlists, thank you!![/h3]
[h3]We have prepared an update for the demo version which includes quality of life improvements and reduce the file size.[/h3]
[h3]We hope these small adjustments help improve the experience of the demo.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45161397/da66ff152a0ca5db2215881e9f596de433ed739e.gif[/img]

[h3]Patch note:[/h3]

[b]added options menu, provides adjustment for:[/b]
[list]
[*] window mode
[*] resolution
[*] language
[*] skip option
[*] BGM volume
[*] SE volume
[*] text speed
[*] auto speed
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45161397/94c307bf155675f9ed82c9acfcd8142396276ae6.png[/img]
[b]added pause menu, for:[/b]
[list]
[*] save game
[*] load game
[*] options menu
[*] quit game
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45161397/fafec65fd2b591f06aba749a92bcb2bb3bd9a56c.png[/img]
[b]some small adjustments:[/b]
[list]
[*] renew recipe tutorial effect.
[*] added effect on Keyword's image.
[*] small adjustment for grammar and wording.
[/list]
[b]file size optimization:[/b]
[list]
[*] Windows: 365MB --> 242MB
[*] macOS: 319MB -->269MB
[/list]

[h2]Please continue to support Yume Kakigori, thank you!![/h2]
